title: fix(objectql): the duplicate-record refusal reaches the writer's locale on the action door and on bulk rows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSUQWB2j9eHYsRcrCiq1X1C)_

Fixes #33790
Clause-②: yes (widening). The /data 409 and the row errors gain a `userMessage` key, with the same text as the end-user sentence. `message` keeps its diagnostic text.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录重复的提示句(如「已存在「工厂」、「牌号」、「成本周次」均相同的记录」)现在在按钮动作、脚本动作、批量编辑和流程里也按用户语言显示,不再只有表单保存才是中文。
- 为什么改:之前通过动作按钮或批量编辑保存时,用户看到的是给工程师看的英文诊断句;席位裁决 B′(6895764754)按维护者裁决 C(6819749037)由错误的产生方统一声明用户句。
- 风险与回滚:只新增一个已有契约字段 `userMessage`,原有 `message`、`error`、`code` 文字不变;回滚即撤回本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/duplicate-record-error.ts`(新增 `userMessage`)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-client-failures.ts`(批量行错误带上它)、新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/duplicate-record-user-message-doors-33790.test.ts`,预期 20 个用例全绿(中文与英文两套)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `DuplicateRecordError` (`@objectstack/objectql`) declares its already-assembled end-user sentence, composed in the writer's locale, as `userMessage`. `endUserMessage` keeps the same text. `message` stays the diagnostic sentence. The module note that said the sentence was deliberately not `userMessage` is replaced by the B′ rule.
- `toRowApiError` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`) carries a producer-declared `userMessage` on a row error, through the same read and bound the `/data` door applies (`boundedDeclaredUserMessage`). A row whose producer marked nothing carries no `userMessage`.
- The sentence names fields by label and quotes no record value, as before.

Every door, changed or declared unchanged (measured on the real stack unless noted):

| door | code changed here | wire change | pin |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST`/`PATCH /data/:object` 409 | no | gains `userMessage`, same text as `error` | card file, the flipped `engine-duplicate-record-label-sentence.test.ts` pin, and the three rest pins |
| `POST /data/:object/createMany` (whole-request 409) | no | gains `userMessage` beside `error` | card file |
| `POST /actions/...`, declarative `operation: 'update'` | no | gains `error.userMessage`; `message` unchanged | card file |
| `POST /actions/...`, sandboxed script body writing through `ctx.api` (QuickJS hand-back) | no | gains `error.userMessage`; the hand-back keeps it | card file |
| `POST /data/:object/updateMany` rows | yes (`toRowApiError`) | rows gain `userMessage`; `message` unchanged | card file |
| `POST /data/:object/batch` rows (`create`, `update`, `upsert`) | yes (`toRowApiError`) | rows gain `userMessage` | card file |
| Hono handler-throw seam (`declaredEnvelopeForThrow`) | no | gains `error.userMessage` | card file, seam asked directly |
| MCP tool error (`actionsDoorAnswerOf`) | no | gains `userMessage` | card file, resolver asked directly |
| Flow inner refusal (`refusalCarriedBy`; the trigger and resume doors) | no | gains `userMessage`; `message` and `innerRefusal.message` unchanged | flipped `service-automation/src/flow-inner-refusal.test.ts` and `verify/src/automation-flow-inner-refusal.test.ts` (zh-CN and en) |
| Import rows (`@objectstack/core` import runner) | no | none: the row adopts the `/data` verdict's `error`, already in the writer's locale | none |

## Tests

- New `packages/runtime/src/duplicate-record-user-message-doors-33790.test.ts`: a real kernel over its Hono app (ObjectQL on sqlite-wasm, REST, dispatcher, auth, security, an app with a declared composite unique index, `zh-CN` labels, a declarative update action and a sandboxed script action). Every door above runs under `Accept-Language: zh-CN` and under an `en` control, with a control row error that carries no `userMessage`. 20 tests.
- Flipped `packages/objectql/src/engine-duplicate-record-label-sentence.test.ts` (the `not.toHaveProperty('userMessage')` pin) to assert `userMessage` equals `error`, en and zh-CN.
- Flipped the flow door's two pins (claim amendment 6907854103): `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-inner-refusal.test.ts` (the unique case, now zh-CN and en) and `packages/verify/src/automation-flow-inner-refusal.test.ts` (the unique cases at the trigger and resume doors, now zh-CN and en). Each asserts the run carries the declared `userMessage` and that `message` keeps the diagnostic.
- Added `userMessage` (equal to `error`) to the expected bodies of seven exact-shape pins on the /data 409 and row errors (claim amendment for the rest surface): `packages/rest/src/rest-duplicate-record-arm.test.ts` (four cases), `packages/rest/src/data-package-scoped-refusal-candidates.test.ts` (the two CONTROL cases, flat 409 and row) and `packages/rest/src/error-response-structured-arm-door-parity.test.ts` (the DUPLICATE_RECORD door-parity row).
- Added `userMessage` (equal to `error`) to the expected 409 bodies of the sku and gsku cases in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/field-unique-rest-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`, the eighth exact-shape pin (claim amendment 6911413595). It pinned the flat `/data` 409 by exact shape and ejected the first enqueue (queue run 43826455262); the dogfood shards run only in the queue.

<details><summary>Ablation (both legs rebuilt the package, proved the marker in dist/, then restored and proved it absent)</summary>

- Producer declaration (`this.userMessage = this.endUserMessage` replaced by a blank string): 19 of 20 card tests red, for example `AssertionError: expected undefined to be '已存在「工厂」、「牌号」、「成本周次」均相同的记录'` on the sandboxed script action. The one green is the control row.
- Row carry (the `userMessage` spread in `toRowApiError` disabled): exactly the 8 row tests red (`updateMany` and the three `batch` operations, both locales); the 12 others stay green.
- Producer declaration again, against the flow pins: the 2 unique cases of `flow-inner-refusal.test.ts` and the 4 unique cases of `automation-flow-inner-refusal.test.ts` red (`expected undefined to be '已存在相同客户名称的记录'`); every other case green.
- Restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, dist preflight `--absent` exit 0, `git status --porcelain` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The flow door's existing pins asserted that the engine's duplicate carries no `userMessage`; ruling B′ turns that false, so they are flipped here under claim amendment 6907854103.
- The dogfood battery is CI's (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).

## Verification

- Final head `da832b2f8` (after merging `origin/main` again): card file 20/20; `@objectstack/service-automation` 284 files, 4041 tests passed; `@objectstack/verify` 52 files, 441 passed; typecheck of service-automation and verify exit 0.
- Head `fd810dc0e`: `@objectstack/objectql` 599 files, 13353 passed; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 344 files, 22946 passed, 45 skipped; typecheck of objectql, metadata-protocol and runtime exit 0. Head `3f7c473bc`: `@objectstack/scenarios` 34 files, 922 passed.
- Pre-merge head `5b4d1738b`, the other direct dependents of objectql and metadata-protocol: runtime 606 files, 11090 passed, 19 skipped; cli `unit` 423 files, 6010 passed; plugin-sharing, plugin-audit, plugin-webhooks, plugin-email, plugin-pinyin-search, plugin-dev, cloud-connection, example-todo, example-embed-objectql green.
- Head `099761b68` (the rest pin flips): `@objectstack/rest` `test` 413 files, 8497 passed, 350 skipped; `test:repo` 5 files, 300 passed, 23 skipped; typecheck exit 0.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` on `da832b2f8` derived 71 families; 69 run locally, all exit 0, plus `pnpm lint` exit 0. The gates that read test files (`check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:tier-file-adoption`) re-run on `099761b68`, exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` are left to CI (`Lint & Repo Gates` success on `099761b68`; `check:type-check-debt` also exit 0 locally on `3f7c473bc`).
- CI on `099761b68`: every required context is success (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core 1-8/8, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check Changeset); the UI build, lint and type-check lanes were skipped by path.
